title: HtmlDel
responsibility: Renders the native del element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlDel.attributes
inputs.description: Native del attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlDel.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native del element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlDel
outputs.description: The actual native del element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
